SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(closure_id AS VARCHAR) a, closure_type b, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) d FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=102
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dups', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(min(sale_date) AS VARCHAR), CAST(max(sale_date) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE store_key IN (3,4) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'chan', channel_code, CAST(staff_purchase_flag AS VARCHAR), CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(quantity) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IN (3,4) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'etl', CAST(CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE) AS VARCHAR), '', CAST(count(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(sum(quantity) AS VARCHAR) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IN (3,4) AND sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE st.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31' AND '2026-09-27'
), r AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, sum(quantity_returned) rq FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.sku, max(p.product_name) nm, sum(s.quantity) units_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT s.staff_purchase_flag THEN s.quantity END) units_nonstaff, sum(coalesce(r.rq,0)) returned_units
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (sales_line_id) JOIN dim_product p ON p.sku=s.sku AND p.is_current
GROUP BY s.sku ORDER BY units_all DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE st.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
